jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

San Francisco; London; New York; Remote

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Applied Research

  

**Own Your Intelligence**
-------------------------

  

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

  

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

  

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

**Role Impact**
---------------

You will build environments, evaluations, agent systems, and post-training methods with an external robotics team. You will train and evaluate agents with reinforcement learning, world modeling, imitation learning, planning, and multimodal perception, using feedback from simulation and deployed robots. The experiments will test behavior under partial observations, long horizons, changing environments, and hardware and safety constraints.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Applied Research at Prime**

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

**Representative early problems**

* Build aligned simulation and real-world evaluations for a long-horizon embodied task, then measure exactly where policies fail to transfer.
* Combine demonstrations, interventions, offline data, and online feedback into a training loop that improves behavior without erasing prior competence.
* Train an embodied agent to recover from partial failures, changing scenes, and uncertain state while respecting safety and hardware constraints.

**What you will own**

* Simulation and real-world environments for training, evaluation, and careful sim-to-real comparison.
* Long-horizon agents that perceive, plan, act, remember, and recover under hardware constraints.
* Training that combines offline and online RL, demonstrations, interventions, and outcome feedback.
* Rewards and evaluations for task success, safety, adaptation, and continual improvement without silent regressions.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Relevant experience: robotics, embodied AI, RL, imitation learning, control, world models, simulation, computer vision, agent evaluation, or production systems interacting with the physical world.
* Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.
* Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.
* Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.
* Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

**Evidence of exceptional work**

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

**Work Arrangement**
--------------------

* Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives
* Full medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and dependents.
* Flexible PTO.
* $200/month health and wellness benefit.
* Visa Sponsorship & relocation support
* Professional development budget for courses and conferences.
* Team off-sites and conference attendance.
* Company-covered meals when working from our San Francisco office.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Early Career - AI Platform, Autonomy
jobs.description:
Rivian's Autonomy AI Platform team builds the software that connects vehicle data to trained and evaluated  
autonomous driving models. Our work spans data infrastructure, large-scale compute and storage, machine  
learning infrastructure, evaluation and visualization, and AI tools that help engineers build better software.  
As a new graduate software engineer joining full-time in 2027, you will help build and improve production  
systems used by Autonomy engineers. You will contribute across design, implementation, testing, and delivery,  
with mentorship from experienced engineers and growing ownership of features and services. Your team and  
projects will be matched to your skills and interests and the team's needs across the areas below

Depending on your background and interests, you may contribute to one or more of the following areas:

* **Data Infrastructure:** Build the systems that turn vehicle sensor data into high-quality datasets for model  
  development. Projects may span data ingestion and processing, automated quality checks, mining and  
  search, annotation and curation tools, dataset versioning and lineage, and data analytics. Help engineers  
  find the right driving examples and understand the data used to train and evaluate their models.
* **Evaluation Infrastructure:**Build the workflows and tools that help autonomy engineers understand model  
  behavior and measure progress. Work may include running simulation and evaluation at scale, comparing  
  model versions, detecting regressions, investigating driving events, and developing metrics dashboards, 3D  
  visualization, or teleoperation tools. Make results easier to reproduce, inspect, and use in development and  
  release decisions.
* **ML Infrastructure:**Help build the platform that enables efficient, reliable model training across accelerator  
  clusters. Projects may include job scheduling and resource management, training data access and caching,  
  distributed training frameworks, experiment tracking, and performance profiling. Work with ML engineers to  
  reduce input bottlenecks, improve accelerator utilization, and shorten the path from an experiment to a  
  useful result.
* **Platform Services:** Build shared software foundations used across Autonomy: distributed compute services,  
  storage and streaming systems, databases and lakehouse services, data catalogs, and reusable backend  
  and full-stack frameworks. Projects may improve APIs, data access, storage efficiency, or performance at  
  scale, with privacy and access controls built into the platform.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Build automation and developer tooling for the cloud environments that support  
  Autonomy. Projects may include infrastructure as code, Kubernetes tooling, build and deployment pipelines,  
  observability, cloud resource efficiency, and integrations with engineering tools and open-source services.  
  Help teams provision resources, ship software, and diagnose infrastructure problems more reliably and  
  efficiently.
* **Applied General AI:** Build AI-powered tools that accelerate engineering work. Projects may include LLM  
  applications, agent runtimes and tool integrations, knowledge retrieval, coding and debugging workflows,  
  and evaluation systems that measure agent quality. Test ideas on real engineering tasks and use evidence  
  to improve their usefulness, reliability, and cost.

  

* You are a current BS or MS candidate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related  
  field.
* You have strong programming and problem-solving skills, with experience in at least one language such as  
  Python, C++, Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript.
* You have a foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering, and experience building and  
  debugging software through coursework, research, personal projects, open-source contributions, or a  
  previous internship.
* You have interest or experience in one or more areas relevant to the team, such as backend or full-stack  
  development, distributed systems, data processing and storage, machine learning, cloud infrastructure,  
  visualization, or software performance.
* You are curious, communicate clearly, collaborate well, and are eager to learn from feedback and take  
  ownership of a project. Prior autonomous driving experience is not required

jobs.title: Research Engineer/Research Scientist-Post Training
jobs.description:
Post-training - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Post-Training team advances OpenAI’s frontier models and prepares them for deployment in ChatGPT, Codex, the API, and future products. We work at the intersection of research and product to make models more capable, useful, safe, and reliable for millions of users.

We define the capabilities our models should have, build the training signals that teach those abilities, and run the experiments that make them real. Our work spans reinforcement learning, model behavior and alignment, reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities such as tool use, computer use, and long-horizon execution. We build the data, environments, evaluations, and training methods that shape model behavior, then carry those improvements through major training runs and into the products people use.

**About the Role**

As a Research Engineer / Research Scientist on Post-Trainingance of OpenAI’s models. You might own a research direction, develop new training methods, build infrastructure for large-scale experiments, or create evaluations that reveal where models fail. You will take ideas from early experimentation through integration and deployment.

We’re looking for people with strong machine learning engineering skills and research experience who are excited about product-driven research. This role is intentionally broad: you should be comfortable taking an ambiguous problem and making progress across research, engineering, data, and evaluations. You will collaborate closely with researchers, product and infrastructure teams, and safety and alignment partners to translate user needs into model improvements and help determine what is ready for major model runs.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**In this role, you might**

* Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capabilitiesance, from defining hypotheses and running experiments to analyzing results and shipping improvements.
* Develop and improve post-training methods and systems, including reinforcement learning, data mixtures, synthetic data, reward signals, graders, and training pipelines.
* Build robust evaluations and environments that measure progress, expose model failures, and turn those findings into better training data, methods, and product experiences.
* Design, implement, test, and debug code across the research stack, improving the reliability, efficiency, observability, and reproducibility of large-scale experiments.
* Collaborate with research and product teams across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API to understand user needs and translate real-world feedback into model improvements.
* Advance capabilities such as reasoning, factuality, instruction following, coding, tool use, and long-horizon task execution, with opportunities to work on computer use and multi-agent collaboration.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Software Engineer II | Global Intelligence, Data Platform  
  
About the team  
  
Global Intelligence helps Uber understand competitive landscapes and marketplace dynamics across Mobility and Delivery. We partner with scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted insights that inform product, pricing, and marketplace decisions.  
  
Our engineering team builds the data foundations behind these insights: integrating external sources, developing scalable data pipelines and models, and creating reusable platform capabilities. We leverage AI to accelerate data integration, improve data understanding, and make our platform easier to operate and use.  
  
About the role  
  
We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent data systems for Global Intelligence. You will take ownership of data platform capabilities from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production operations. Working with engineers, scientists, and product, you’ll navigate incomplete requirements, resolve ambiguity, and translate business and analytical needs into maintainable engineering solutions.  
  
This role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on data engineering. You’ll build ETL/ELT pipelines, design data models and contracts, strengthen data quality, and apply AI to meaningfully improve our workflows and products.  
  
What you’ll do  

* **Drive problems from discovery to production.** Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify dependencies, evaluate alternatives, and deliver solutions with measurable impact.
* **Design and build ETL/ELT systems.** Develop scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines that integrate heterogeneous external and internal data sources, supporting incremental processing, orchestration, backfills, and recovery.
* **Develop durable data models.** Define dataset grain, keys, relationships, and historical behavior, build reusable models that support analytical, scientific, and downstream product needs.
* **Establish data contracts.** Define and maintain expectations for schemas, semantics, freshness, completeness, and compatibility. Manage schema evolution and changes across producers and consumers.
* **Build quality into the platform.** Implement validation, reconciliation, automated testing, and observability to detect missing, duplicated, delayed, or inconsistent data before it affects downstream decisions.
* **Apply system-design judgment.** Make thoughtful tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, reliability, latency, cost, and maintainability. Reuse existing infrastructure and develop shared abstractions where appropriate.
* **Build with and for AI.** Identify and evaluate opportunities to use AI for workflows such as schema mapping, data extraction, quality investigation, and developer productivity. Build the validation, evaluation, and safeguards needed to make these capabilities dependable.
* **Own production outcomes.** Monitor pipeline health and data reliability, troubleshoot incidents, address root causes, and improve operational tooling and documentation.
* **Collaborate and raise engineering quality.** Contribute to code reviews and design discussions, share knowledge, and improve the maintainability and usability of the systems you support.

  
Basic qualifications

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Computer Vision
jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
* **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
* **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
* **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
* **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
* **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
* **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
* **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
* **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
* **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
* **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing.

Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**About Hammerhead**
--------------------

Hammerhead AI tackles one of the hardest problems in AI: the collision between exploding compute demand and the hard limits of the power grid. Our platform uses reinforcement learning to coordinate power, cooling, and compute in real time, unlocking more AI capacity from data centers that are already built. Our founders built and scaled AutoGrid, the AI grid-software company **acquired by Schneider Electric**. Our **oversubscribed $10M seed round** was led by Buoyant Ventures with SE Ventures, and we are part of NVIDIA Inception. Learn more at **hammerheadco.ai**.

**About the role**
------------------

**We’re hiring a Data Scientist to build the forecasting and optimization behind our platform: working out how much more AI capacity a running data center can safely take, and proving it. You’ll work directly with our reinforcement learning and engineering teams on the problem every AI company now has: power.**

Hammerhead unlocks usable power inside data centers that are already built and already carrying customer load. Working out how much more capacity a site can take, and under what conditions, is a hard quantitative problem under real uncertainty, with physical and commercial consequences if the answer is wrong. You’ll own that problem: forecasting, scenario modeling and optimization applied to real infrastructure, where the answer has to hold up both operationally and commercially.

In your first 90 days you’ll get to know our site data and existing models, take ownership of the forecasting pipeline for live site assessments, and set up the backtesting that tells us how far we can trust each model. Success in your first year means production forecasts and capacity assessments that our commercial and delivery teams rely on, documented well enough to stand up to customer and external technical review.

This is a full-time, on-site role in our Redwood City office, working alongside our reinforcement learning and platform engineering teams. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Product.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Forecasting:** Build and own probabilistic load forecasts for data center sites across operational and planning horizons.
* **Capacity under uncertainty:** Model site behavior to quantify available capacity and how confident we can be in it.
* **Optimization:** Develop the optimization across power, cooling and storage that turns forecasts into operating decisions.
* **Validation:** Build the backtesting and validation framework that tells us when a model is good enough to rely on.
* **Production:** Instrument and monitor models in production, and improve them as sites, hardware and workloads change.
* **Decisions, not just models:** Turn model output into decisions the business can act on, and explain how the model works, what it found and what it means to non-technical colleagues and customers.
* **Documentation:** Document methodology to a standard that survives customer and external technical review.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with reinforcement learning, platform engineering, solutions and delivery so models fit the decisions each team has to make.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years building forecasting or optimization models that ran in production and that people depended on.
* Have taken a model from prototype to deployment and owned it in production, including support.
* Strong in probabilistic forecasting and Monte Carlo simulation.
* Experience with time series at scale, including messy, incomplete telemetry from physical equipment.
* Strong Python scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy) plus an optimization library such as Pyomo, CVXPY, Gurobi or CPLEX.
* Experience with control optimization, control theory or energy optimization.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field.
* Clear communicator, in writing and in person, with technical and business colleagues.
* Able to work on-site in our Redwood City office, with or without reasonable accommodation.

### **Preferred**

* Experience with data center power and cooling, or industrial process telemetry.
* Energy domain experience: distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, battery dispatch, demand response or wholesale market optimization.
* Comfort with reinforcement learning or model predictive control.
* Work where model error carried financial consequences: pricing, revenue management, capacity planning or trading.
* Uses AI coding and analysis tools day to day to move faster.

**Interview process**
---------------------

* Application review
* Initial screen
* First-round interview
* Second-round interview
* Offer

**Pay and benefits**
--------------------

* **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000 per year. This range is our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay at hire. The final offer depends on skills and experience.
* **Equity:** stock options, so you share in the value you help create.
* **Health and wellbeing:** Anthem, Kaiser, or Cigna medical plans, plus Guardian dental (with orthodontia) and vision, all from your first day; a monthly company HSA contribution on eligible plans; Spring Health therapy and coaching; and One Medical membership.
* **Time off:** Flexible Time Off (we encourage at least 15 days a year), 15+ paid holidays, 9 days of paid sick leave, and up to 12 weeks of parental leave at full base pay.

jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Every capture tells a story: what someone did, when they did it and whether they completed the task. At Mecka, you’ll build vision-language and video models that turn that footage into useful annotations and catch quality issues across more video than a human team could review.

You’ll own the work from data selection and training through evaluation and production. We’re looking for someone who brings strong research instincts and the engineering skills to make models reliable at scale—and who wants to understand where they fail as much as where they succeed.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models that understand the footage.** You’ll develop and improve vision-language and video models for egocentric and manipulation footage.
* **Catch problems across what we collect.** You’ll build model pipelines that identify capture defects, missing coverage and task errors, then check their performance against human audits.
* **Make models more reliable.** You’ll use supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve reliability and reasoning.
* **Turn video into useful annotations.** You’ll build pipelines for captioning, temporal grounding and video annotation at scale.
* **Take experiments through to production.** You’ll run large experiments on distributed GPU infrastructure, analyze the results and turn successful approaches into production systems.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Hands-on experience with large multimodal models.** You’ve trained, fine-tuned or post-trained vision-language or multimodal models.
* **Strong deep learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with PyTorch or JAX.
* **Experience running large experiments.** You can design an experiment, see it through and draw sound conclusions from the results.
* **Familiarity with distributed training.** You know your way around GPU-based development and distributed training infrastructure.
* **Research instincts and engineering discipline.** You ask good questions, test your assumptions and build clean systems that hold up beyond the experiment.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Footage quality control:** Using vision-language and video models to identify defects and gaps in captured data.
* **Video understanding and annotation:** Structured captioning, temporal grounding and scene understanding.
* **Training and post-training:** Reward modeling, synthetic data, and data curation and filtering for multimodal models.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Material Planning Analytics team provides dedicated analytical support to Tesla's supply chain operations - driving process improvements and better decisions with data.

You will be the primary Data Scientist for Material Planning's planning solver: the optimization engine that turns material requirements into executable inbound supply plans across Tesla's factories and service network. It decides what to order, when to ship, and how to load every truck and container - decisions that drive millions of dollars of freight and inventory impact.

You will own the algorithms and models end-to-end: problem formulation, heuristic design, simulation, validation, production deployment, and ongoing troubleshooting. You will partner closely with planners, logistics, and software engineering, and draw on the standards, tools, and expertise of the central Analytics team.

The ideal candidate is a curious, driven data scientist with deep algorithmic and optimization skills. You should be strong at formulating hard planning problems, tracing unexpected system results to root cause, building trust with stakeholders, and turning models into business impact.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own inbound planning algorithms end-to-end across manufacturing and service warehouses - from problem formulation and prototyping through testing and production rollout - covering order quantities, shipment timing, and how parts are packed into trucks and containers
* Design and implement optimization models, algorithms, and heuristics that balance solution quality against runtime at production scale
* Extend planning models to new problems and network flows, working with planners and logistics to turn business rules into constraints and logic, then roll the changes out
* Build simulation and what-if tools to stress-test planning logic and evaluate network and policy changes, quantifying cost, utilization, and inventory impact before rollout
* Partner with software engineering to ship improvements into production applications - writing clean, tested Python and improving speed and robustness
* Validate model outputs against business rules and actual shipments - investigating unexpected results, tracing them to root cause across data, configuration, and model logic, and driving fixes to closure. Build automated checks and dashboards that track system performance and flag issues early, so issues surface before they reach operations
* Partner with planners, Logistics, Supply Chain Managers, IT, and systems teams - supporting leadership with analyses and impact estimates, and independently managing multiple concurrent projects to deadline

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in a quantitative field such as Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science, or equivalent experience with evidence of exceptional ability; 2+ years applying optimization, algorithms, or simulation to supply chain planning, logistics, transportation, or a related field
* Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures, with a demonstrated ability to design, analyze, and implement custom heuristics and combinatorial algorithms for large, real-world problems; familiarity with classic operations research problems (bin packing, vehicle routing, lot sizing, inventory optimization) and with material planning or logistics systems
* Strong proficiency in mathematical programming (LP/MILP; constraint programming a plus), with hands-on experience using optimization solvers and modeling tools (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, CBC, PuLP, or similar)
* Experience building simulation models (discrete-event, Monte Carlo, or similar) and using them to evaluate policies and quantify impact
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for modeling, querying large datasets, and writing production-quality code and automated pipelines (Airflow or similar)

jobs.description:
Foundations - San Francisco

  

### **About the Team**

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundationsation. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Researcher to lead our safety and alignment research: building the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material.

The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolations, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define the technical direction for Safety + Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize.
* Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content.
* Discover useful signals across page contents, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation.
* Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces.
* Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on.
* Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems.

### **You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have**

* Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale.
* Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems.
* An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems.
* A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production.
* Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work.
* A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve.

jobs.title: Early Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
**About Multiply**

Multiply is building the AI-native media agency for B2B companies, combining AI agents with expert strategists to transform how businesses run and optimize paid advertising.

Our platform connects to advertising channels, CRMs, and customer data to continuously create, manage, and optimize campaigns. We're building autonomous AI agents that make decisions, execute workflows, learn from results, and improve performance over time. We're also building a Marketing Intelligence platform that learns from thousands of campaigns and ads to uncover insights about buyers, creative performance, and channels, making every campaign and Ad smarter than the last.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup tackling complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI, automation, and large-scale marketing data. Our goal is to fundamentally change how marketing gets done.

**Role Description**

We're looking for an exceptional AI-native engineer who loves building products, solving hard problems, and shipping fast.

As an early engineer at Multiply, you'll work directly with the founders to build and scale our AI-powered platform. You'll have significant ownership over product features, technical architecture, and engineering decisions.

This isn't a role where you'll be handed detailed specifications. You'll take ambiguous problems, figure out what matters, and ship solutions to customers. You'll work across the stack, from intuitive product experiences to sophisticated AI agents and backend systems.

You'll join a small, ambitious team in San Francisco where your work will have an immediate impact on our product, customers, and company.

**What you’ll do**

* **Build AI-powered products**: Own and ship end-to-end features that customers use every day, from intuitive interfaces to complex backend systems.
* **Develop autonomous AI agents**: Build agents that reason, plan, execute actions, and continuously improve marketing workflows.
* **Engineer reliable AI systems**: Design agent orchestration, tool integrations, evaluations, observability, and feedback loops to make AI systems dependable in production.
* **Integrate data and build intelligence:** Connect advertising platforms, CRMs, and other data sources to power intelligent automation, uncover insights, and improve decision-making.
* **Move fast with AI**: Leverage AI coding tools and modern development workflows to prototype, build, and ship at exceptional speed without compromising quality.
* **Own problems end-to-end**: Work directly with founders and customers to turn ambiguous ideas into working products, from initial design through production.
* **Shape our engineering foundation**: Influence architecture, tooling, technical decisions, and engineering culture as the team grows.

**What We Mean by "AI-Native"**

AI isn't just a feature we're building — it's fundamental to how we build software.

We expect engineers to actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI-powered development tools to accelerate development, testing, and experimentation.

We're looking for engineers who constantly explore new AI capabilities, rethink traditional development workflows, and combine AI-driven speed with strong engineering judgment.

**Qualifications**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and shipping production applications across the stack.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI development tools and a demonstrated ability to use them effectively.
* Experience building AI-powered applications or workflows, ideally using LLMs or agents.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take ambiguous problems from idea to production.
* Product-minded engineering approach — you care about the user experience and business impact, not just the code.
* Comfortable moving quickly, learning new technologies, and making pragmatic technical trade-offs.
* High ownership, curiosity, and a bias toward action.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration, tool calling, or evaluation systems.
* Experience building integrations with third-party APIs or complex data systems.
* Previous experience at an early-stage startup or building your own products.

You will own features end to end and ship them to customers, with support from experienced senior engineers. The Software Engineer will report to the Head of Engineering and play a crucial role in building the future of Amplify.

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**OUR COMPANY**

As an early mover in the in-space transportation and infrastructure services, Momentus is at the forefront of the commercialization of space. With an experienced team of aerospace, propulsion, and robotics engineers, Momentus has developed a cost-effective and energy-efficient in-space transport system.

**OUR PEOPLE**

Daring problems require daring solutions. We boldly charge into uncharted territory knowing that no matter the outcome we will benefit from the journey and move closer to our goals no matter what. Our teams know that working at Momentus means more than building innovative technology, it means creating entirely new markets in the space economy. We are level-headed, business-minded strategic thinkers intent on providing immediate value to our customers today while simultaneously preparing for the vast possibilities of the future. If this sounds like you, we should talk.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Flight Software Engineer that will design, develop and test software that is used to control flight systems. The ideal candidate should be accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working on challenging problems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Validate, test, and extend vendor and/or open source software packages
* Develop software applications to support spacecraft automation & testing
* Develop software applications to support on-orbit operations
* Support on-orbit operations and flight anomaly resolution activities

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Extensive knowledge of Python, C++, C
* Experience with Linux shell scripting
* Experience with either
  + NASA core Flight System (cFS)
  + Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2)
* Ability to work independently
* Excellent technical communications skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

* Knowledge of spacecraft operations and/or astrodynamics
* Familiar with Linux server configuration and administration.
* Experience with the Yocto embedded Linux environment
* Experience with developing Linux device drivers
* Experience with the Rust programming language
* Previous experience working on DoD and other USG development and deployment programs
* Ability to hold and maintain a USG Security Clearance

**Education & Work Experience:**

* BS degree in Computer Science, or a closely related discipline
* 5-8 years relevant experience.

**Compensation:**

Annual Base Salary Range: $140,000 - $175,000/per year

Base pay is one part of our total compensation package (base+bonus+equity) and is determined within a range. Your actual base salary will be determined on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Our benefit plans include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan, short and long term disability and life insurance. We also offer flexible PTO, along with 11 paid holidays, sick time and paid parental leave.

This is a full-time position in San Jose, California. This position requires access to export-controlled commodities, technical data, technology, software, and services. U.S. citizenship, U.S. legal permanent resident status, or protected person status under 8 U.S.C. Â§ 1324b(a)(3) is required.

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla’s SI Data Infra team is charged with collecting and processing all the data that fuels the development of FSD and Optimus. Every car and robot includes a sophisticated sensor suite and internet connectivity. This allows us to gather data from our fleet of millions of vehicles around the world to feed the training of our SI models, providing Tesla with a significant competitive advantage in the race to full autonomy. The Data Infra team is responsible for the full lifecycle of this data: from specifying interesting events for data collection, to efficiently recording as much relevant data as possible on our embedded autopilot computer, to processing the data in the cloud.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Build new frameworks and applications for collecting data on our embedded Linux platform
* Improve monitoring and metrics throughout our entire software stack
* Increase scalability of our data collection as SI data needs continue to grow
* Bring up telemetry for new types of sensors, vehicle platforms and robots
* Work closely with all consumers of our data, including SI modeling, training infrastructure, and data labeling teams
* Contribute to other parts of the SI software stack, including perception and control algorithms

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Experience programming C/C++ software, including modern C/C++ (C++11/14/17/20) and multithreading
* Strong Linux fundamentals (embedded environments, preferred)
* Experience with efficient networking and disk I/O
* Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
* Contributions to open source projects is a plus

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform IOT
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

The Platform IoT team runs the device cloud that keeps Motive devices connected. We own the full path between devices and the cloud, including provisioning and identity, messaging, firmware updates and certificates, configuration delivery, data ingestion, and monitoring. Our platform supports more than 1 million connected devices across North America and Europe.

As a Software Engineer on the team, you’ll build and monitor the services behind these systems and own projects end-to-end—from design and well-tested code to safe deployment and production operations. You’ll work with backend, firmware, and product engineers to solve the challenges of keeping a large fleet secure, up to date, and reporting data. We’re looking for an infrastructure or cloud engineer with strong engineering fundamentals, depth in at least one of our focus areas, and a commitment to production ownership.

This role is based in San Francisco and requires two days (Tuesdays/Thursdays) per week in the office.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* Design, build, and deploy reliable, maintainable, and performant services in Go and Ruby, AWS Lambda functions, and Terraform-managed infrastructure.
* Build and monitor the platform that teams use to roll out firmware and configuration to devices.
* Improve dashboards, alerts, and observability so the team can identify and address issues proactively.
* Support new hardware launches, including provisioning, factory enablement, and related device-side features.
* Build and improve Kafka, Flink, and MQTT data ingestion pipelines for device telemetry and files.
* Participate in the team’s on-call rotation and improve runbooks and tooling to make on-call easier.
* Help manage technical debt by consolidating approaches and making pragmatic decisions about what to improve and when.
* Write clear design documents, provide thoughtful code reviews, and keep documentation current for the systems you own.
* Collaborate effectively with teammates across time zones.

### **What We’re Looking For:**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating backend or distributed services in production.
* Proficiency with AI tools and automation, including AI-assisted coding.
* Strong coding skills in Go or a similar language (such as Java, Python, or Rust) and a willingness to work in Go.
* Experience building and operating services on AWS, including serverless services such as Lambda and infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
* Understanding of networking and security fundamentals, including TLS, certificates, and authentication between services and devices.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting, and a habit of instrumenting the systems you build.
* Ability to debug issues across system boundaries and explain findings in plain language.
* Clear written communication skills, including the ability to write design documents that teammates in other time zones can act on.
* Preferred: Experience with Ruby.
* Preferred: Working knowledge of messaging and streaming systems such as MQTT and Kafka.
* Preferred: Experience with connected devices, IoT platforms, or firmware delivery.
* Preferred: Experience with Kubernetes, stream processing frameworks such as Flink, or factory provisioning flows for hardware products.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always-on background workers to the platform.

jobs.description:
**About Lumafield:**

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA.

**About the role:**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer at Lumafield, you will own the cloud platform that runs Voyager, our CT data platform. A scan is only useful once someone can open it, measure it, and make a decision, and that happens in Voyager, in a web browser. Everything underneath is yours: AWS, the production Kubernetes clusters, Terraform, the pipeline every engineer ships through, observability, and the cloud side of our security and compliance programs.

This is an ownership role, not a ticket queue. Nobody will hand you a backlog; you will be the person who knows what the platform needs, what it costs, and what to fix first. We expect you to grow into a senior engineer here.

You will work in Platform Engineering alongside the backend lead, the software engineers who ship through your pipeline every day, and the team building the on-prem version of Voyager for customers who cannot send scan data to the cloud. You will report to engineering leadership; Platform Engineering is part of the organization our new Head of Software will lead.

This is a hands-on, in-person role based in our San Francisco, CA office.

  

### **What you'll do:**

* Own our AWS accounts and regions: architecture, access, onboarding and offboarding, and a bill you can explain by service and environment, then bring down
* Run the production EKS clusters, and carry Kubernetes version upgrades from plan and rehearsal to completion, with a rollback ready
* Keep infrastructure and Kubernetes configuration in Terraform, so changes go through code review instead of the console
* Own CI/CD - GitHub Actions, CI runners, artifact and image storage, and GitOps deploys with ArgoCD - and make it faster and more reliable in ways engineers notice
* Own observability (Sentry, Logz.io and Postman today) and decide what the platform needs next; take on-call, and close every incident with a written postmortem and a fix
* Own the cloud side of our SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 programs: least-privilege access, logging, encryption, cluster hardening, and audit evidence that comes out of the system instead of being assembled by hand
* Partner with our IT team on shared controls, and raise the platform's security bar as we maintain CMMC Level 1 and ITAR compliance and work toward FedRAMP 20x
* Document the platform - runbooks, postmortems, and design notes - so it does not live in one person's head

### **About you:**

* You have been on the hook for a production platform: releases, incidents, and on-call
* You have upgraded a production Kubernetes cluster and can tell us what went wrong and what you changed afterwards
* You write Terraform that other people depend on, and you are comfortable with modules, state, and reading a plan before you apply it
* You have built or rebuilt a CI/CD pipeline that engineers used daily
* You have opened a cloud bill, found what was driving it, and changed it
* You have implemented a security control or produced audit evidence for a program such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or done the equivalent access and hardening work without the audit
* You write clearly: runbooks, postmortems, and design notes someone else can act on
* Production experience on ECS rather than Kubernetes, or on GCP/GKE rather than AWS, still counts when your infrastructure-as-code work is strong; tell us how you would close the gap

### **Bonus:**

* Large-file or 3D data pipelines, or GPU workloads
* Software that talks to hardware in the field
* Regulated environments such as FedRAMP, ITAR, or CMMC

Lumafield offers both competitive cash and equity compensation, as well as a health & wellness stipend, 401k, parental leave, flexible PTO, commuter benefits, company wide events and more!

Lumafield is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, because the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Do you feel like your skills don’t meet every single requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway – If you’re excited about our technology, the opportunity, and are eager to learn more we’d love to hear from you!

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information or veteran status.

Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

Flight Software links together the mechanical, avionics, algorithmic, and embedded worlds to actually make the airplane fly. As a Build Software Engineer on the Platform Engineering team, you are a software engineer who is passionate about build systems and making the developer experience meaningfully better. You will design and maintain the systems that build, test and deploy the entire flight software suite—this includes developing custom Rust command line tools.

As a Build Software Engineer, you will be part of the Platform Engineering team. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

As an HPC & AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will work in a highly technical, hands-on environment supporting large-scale CPU and GPU compute platforms across on-premises and cloud environments.

jobs.title: Network Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Opplane**

Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation.

We work with businesses across complex, data-intensive industries to turn fragmented or difficult-to-use data into trusted, actionable intelligence. Our work spans connectivity technologies, AI and data solutions for banking and fintech, and data governance and modernization.

Our founders and leadership team bring decades of experience in networking, wireless and telecom, having built and scaled multiple technology companies, several of them acquired by leading networking and technology players. Drawing on years of selling networking infrastructure, we are involved in building critical infrastructure for telecom operators, developing carrier-grade, software-based solutions that help them deliver secure, scalable connectivity to their enterprise customers.

**Why this role matters**

Our connectivity solutions run in the networks of major telecom operators and the enterprises they serve. Deploying them well takes more than configuration. It takes someone who understands the client’s network, can explain clearly what our solution does, and earns the client’s trust along the way.

In this role, you’ll be the main technical contact for our clients during deployments: shaping how our products fit their environments, working through issues with them, and bringing what you learn back to our Product and Engineering teams. You’ll also be well placed to spot where else we can help.

**What you’ll do**

* Act as the main technical contact for clients, from design discussions through deployment and operation
* Work with clients to understand their networks and requirements, and shape how our solutions fit them
* Lead transport and routing work during deployments, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN and IPsec VPN
* Deploy and support our solutions on cloud platforms, including VNFs and CNFs on OpenStack and public clouds
* Automate deployments and operations with infrastructure as code (Python, Ansible, Terraform)
* Troubleshoot complex issues across network, cloud and Linux environments, and explain clearly what’s happening and what comes next
* Bring client insight back to Product and Engineering, and flag where Opplane could help furthe

**What you’ll bring**

Experience and expertise

* 5+ years as a network engineer, including client-facing work such as solution design, deployments or technical advisory
* Strong hands-on routing: deploying and troubleshooting BGP and OSPF, ideally in large, operator-scale environments
* Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, VXLAN and L2/L3 VPN, and of WAN technologies such as SD-WAN and IPsec VPN
* A good understanding of 4G LTE and 5G core networks, including mobile private networks
* Experience with VNFs and CNFs and with cloud networking, including OpenStack (Heat templates)
* Infrastructure as code with Python, Ansible or Terraform, and Git
* Comfort troubleshooting in Linux-based environments
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or IT, or equivalent experience
* Fluent English, written and spoken

How you work

* You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences, and connect them to what matters for the client
* You use good judgment about what to share with clients, and handle sensitive situations with honesty and discretion
* You notice client needs beyond the immediate project and raise them with the team
* You stay calm and constructive when a client is under pressure
* You’re comfortable being the client’s main contact, without a large team behind you
* You’re willing to travel to client sites

Nice to have

* Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies
* Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI
* SDN and distributed systems
* Overlay and tunnelling technologies
* CCNA/CCNP or Linux certifications
* Start-up experience

**What you’ll have the opportunity to do**

* Shape how our connectivity solutions are deployed in operator and enterprise networks
* Work across routing, mobile core, cloud and automation, not just one layer
* Influence the product directly, with your client insight feeding Product and Engineering

jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

When a robotics team trains on Mecka’s data, they need to trust what they’re getting. You’ll define what that trust rests on: the benchmarks, audits and quality standards behind every delivery. You’ll dig into the failures that averages hide, question results that look too good and make the call on whether data is ready to ship.

You’ll work across Computer Vision, annotation, operations and delivery. We’re looking for someone with a machine learning and data science background who enjoys getting to the bottom of a difficult measurement problem, and can turn what they find into a quality bar the whole team can use.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the benchmark methodology: which evaluation sets exist, how they are sampled, which metrics apply and how versions are frozen and compared.
* Write customer quality specifications and audit rubrics, and keep both aligned with what customers actually reject.
* Run human audits and work with annotation and operations on sampling, agreement, throughput and cost.
* Build automated checks and graders that reduce manual review costs and are hard to game.
* Track where recorded hours are lost, report quality results regularly and make the ship or no-ship call on data.

### **What you need**

* Experience in evaluation, measurement or data quality for machine learning systems, or in data operations at scale.
* A machine learning and data science background, with strong Python and working knowledge of statistics: sampling, precision and recall, agreement and confidence intervals.
* Experience designing evaluation protocols and ground-truth pipelines from scratch.
* The judgment to challenge a research team’s numbers and support that challenge with evidence.
* An eye for how a metric can be gamed, and the habit of closing those gaps.

### **Nice to have**

* **Benchmarks and metrics:** 3D pose, trajectory and reconstruction metrics such as MPJPE and ATE.
* **Audits and data quality:** Sampling design, inter-annotator agreement, loss accounting and managing annotators or vendors.
* **Automated checks and graders:** Verifiers, learned scoring, active learning and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* **Data curation and scoring:** Quality scoring, filtering and composition of large datasets.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

Mecka captures how people move, work and interact with the physical world. The footage is messy: hands disappear behind objects, cameras turn quickly, and motion blur hides the details. You’ll build models that make sense of it—and turn it into accurate 3D data that robotics teams can train on.

We’re looking for machine learning engineers with depth in pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction who want to own what happens after the experiment works. You’ll train models, investigate where they fail and get them running reliably in production, working across the perception stack along the way.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Build models for the problems in front of us.** You’ll train vision models from scratch on large multi-view, multi-sensor datasets, developing new losses and architectures where existing methods fall short.
* **Work through the difficult footage.** You’ll tackle motion blur, fast rotation, heavy occlusion and partial views of hands, bodies and objects.
* **Find out where your models fail.** You’ll evaluate them on our own video, measuring real error and failure rates alongside public benchmark results.
* **Own the path to production.** You’ll optimize GPU performance, make results reproducible, integrate models into our data pipeline and ship releases you can roll back.
* **Follow problems through to a fix.** You’ll reproduce customer-reported issues, understand what went wrong and deliver a fix. You’ll also prototype quickly as new perception problems come up.

### **What you’ll bring**

* **Strong machine learning fundamentals.** You’re comfortable building and training models with Python and PyTorch.
* **Experience training large vision models from scratch.** Your experience goes beyond running or fine-tuning existing models.
* **Depth in a computer vision specialty.** You’ve worked deeply in at least one area, such as pose estimation, SLAM or 3D reconstruction.
* **Experience owning models in production.** You’ve shipped a model or perception component and stayed responsible for it afterward.
* **Comfort with the work as it is.** You can make progress with noisy real-world data and adapt when priorities shift.

### **Nice to have**

Experience in one or more of these areas would be valuable:

* **Hand and body tracking:** 3D hand and full-body tracking, mesh recovery, human-object and human-scene interaction, and estimating contact with objects and the ground.
* **SLAM, VIO and calibration:** Learned ego-motion, optical flow, online calibration and metric scale.
* **3D reconstruction and objects:** Feed-forward or per-scene reconstruction, Gaussian splatting or NeRF, and neural 3D object estimation from egocentric video.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

**DESCRIPTION**

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.  
  
We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist on this team you will:  
  

* Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
* Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
* Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
* Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
* Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
* Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
* Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
* Raise the science bar: review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.  
  
Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Evals & Data Quality
jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

### **The role**

When a robotics team trains on Mecka’s data, they need to trust what they’re getting. You’ll define what that trust rests on: the benchmarks, audits and quality standards behind every delivery. You’ll dig into the failures that averages hide, question results that look too good and make the call on whether data is ready to ship.

You’ll work across Computer Vision, annotation, operations and delivery. We’re looking for someone with a machine learning and data science background who enjoys getting to the bottom of a difficult measurement problem, and can turn what they find into a quality bar the whole team can use.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the benchmark methodology: which evaluation sets exist, how they are sampled, which metrics apply and how versions are frozen and compared.
* Write customer quality specifications and audit rubrics, and keep both aligned with what customers actually reject.
* Run human audits and work with annotation and operations on sampling, agreement, throughput and cost.
* Build automated checks and graders that reduce manual review costs and are hard to game.
* Track where recorded hours are lost, report quality results regularly and make the ship or no-ship call on data.

### **What you need**

* Experience in evaluation, measurement or data quality for machine learning systems, or in data operations at scale.
* A machine learning and data science background, with strong Python and working knowledge of statistics: sampling, precision and recall, agreement and confidence intervals.
* Experience designing evaluation protocols and ground-truth pipelines from scratch.
* The judgment to challenge a research team’s numbers and support that challenge with evidence.
* An eye for how a metric can be gamed, and the habit of closing those gaps.

### **Nice to have**

* **Benchmarks and metrics:** 3D pose, trajectory and reconstruction metrics such as MPJPE and ATE.
* **Audits and data quality:** Sampling design, inter-annotator agreement, loss accounting and managing annotators or vendors.
* **Automated checks and graders:** Verifiers, learned scoring, active learning and human-in-the-loop evaluation.
* **Data curation and scoring:** Quality scoring, filtering and composition of large datasets.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$200K
