Applied Research

  

**Own Your Intelligence**
-------------------------

  

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

  

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

  

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

**Role Impact**
---------------

You will build environments, evaluations, agent systems, and post-training methods with an external robotics team. You will train and evaluate agents with reinforcement learning, world modeling, imitation learning, planning, and multimodal perception, using feedback from simulation and deployed robots. The experiments will test behavior under partial observations, long horizons, changing environments, and hardware and safety constraints.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Applied Research at Prime**

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

**Representative early problems**

* Build aligned simulation and real-world evaluations for a long-horizon embodied task, then measure exactly where policies fail to transfer.
* Combine demonstrations, interventions, offline data, and online feedback into a training loop that improves behavior without erasing prior competence.
* Train an embodied agent to recover from partial failures, changing scenes, and uncertain state while respecting safety and hardware constraints.

**What you will own**

* Simulation and real-world environments for training, evaluation, and careful sim-to-real comparison.
* Long-horizon agents that perceive, plan, act, remember, and recover under hardware constraints.
* Training that combines offline and online RL, demonstrations, interventions, and outcome feedback.
* Rewards and evaluations for task success, safety, adaptation, and continual improvement without silent regressions.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Relevant experience: robotics, embodied AI, RL, imitation learning, control, world models, simulation, computer vision, agent evaluation, or production systems interacting with the physical world.
* Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.
* Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.
* Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.
* Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

**Evidence of exceptional work**

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

* Full medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and dependents.

* $200/month health and wellness benefit.
* Visa Sponsorship & relocation support
* Professional development budget for courses and conferences.
* Team off-sites and conference attendance.
* Company-covered meals when working from our San Francisco office.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
**Location**

San Francisco; London; New York; Remote

Full time

**Department**

Applied Research

  

**Own Your Intelligence**
-------------------------

  

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

  

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

  

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

**Role Impact**
---------------

Chip design is a natural fit for agentic reinforcement learning: long-horizon work, specialized tools, expensive mistakes, hard constraints, and objective feedback from simulation, verification, timing, power, and area. You will build agents, environments, evaluations, and post-training systems for real semiconductor design and verification workflows. The work is grounded in an external design workflow, with access to relevant domain experts and toolchains. It may span RTL generation and debugging, formal verification, simulation, physical design, optimization, and orchestration across EDA tools.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Applied Research at Prime**

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

**Representative early problems**

* Build an interactive verification environment where an agent reads a specification, writes or repairs RTL, invokes simulation or formal tools, interprets failures, and iterates toward a verified result.
* Design rewards and evaluations that combine functional correctness with tool efficiency, robustness, and performance/power/area constraints without opening easy shortcuts.
* Train long-horizon agents to recover from design and tool failures, preserve useful state, and generalize across blocks, designs, and constraint sets.

**What you will own**

* Interactive environments where agents use EDA tools to modify designs, debug failures, and plan multi-step work.
* Verifiers and rewards grounded in tests, simulation, formal methods, design rules, and engineering outcomes.
* Experiments on credit assignment when feedback arrives late and several tools contribute.
* Evaluations for correctness, recovery, and generalization, with reusable methods for other simulator-grounded engineering domains.

**Requirements**
----------------

* We are looking first for depth in RL, agents, or post-training systems and the ability to become fluent in semiconductor workflows.
* Prior work in design automation, compilers, formal methods, or ML for systems is useful but not required.
* Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.
* Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.
* Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.
* Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

**Evidence of exceptional work**

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

**Work Arrangement**
--------------------

* Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives
* Full medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and dependents.
* Flexible PTO.
* $200/month health and wellness benefit.
* Visa Sponsorship & relocation support
* Professional development budget for courses and conferences.
* Team off-sites and conference attendance.
* Company-covered meals when working from our San Francisco office.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
Data Science - San Francisco

  

**About the Team**
==================

OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. Our work spans payment and promotional abuse, compromised accounts and API credentials, business and advertiser integrity, and emerging misuse of frontier AI capabilities. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing.

Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions.

  

**About the Role**
==================

As a Data Scientist on Integrity, you’ll find emerging abuse patterns, size their impact, and lead the analytical work behind decisions about detection, enforcement, and product launches. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Research, Policy, and Operations to turn findings into improvements and measure what happens after they ship.

* Investigate anomalous activity across products. Estimate how common a problem is, who is affected, and what it costs users or the business. Use that evidence to recommend where to focus.
* Define outcome metrics and guardrailsance.
* Help build and evaluate detection rules, classifiers, and human review workflows. Use labeled samples and review outcomes to understand what the systems miss, where they flag legitimate activity, and how those errors vary across users and products.
* Design randomized holdouts and use quasi-experimental or observational methods when randomization is impractical. Estimate harm or fraud losses prevented alongside effects on legitimate users, revenue, compute costs, and review workload. Recommend whether to launch, expand, adjust, or retire a control.
* Trace where signals, review decisions, or enforcement actions break down. Work with partners to close gaps and build reusable datasets, analyses, and investigation tools.

**Ideal Candidate**
===================

* You use AI tools to investigate large, messy datasets, test hypotheses quickly, and automate recurring analyses. You’re fluent in SQL and Python and can verify AI-generated queries, code, and conclusions against the underlying data.
* You have strong statistical judgment and experience with experimentation, causal inference, or observational analysis. You can reason from incomplete or biased labels and explain how uncertainty affects a decision.
* You take ownership of open-ended problems, from deciding what to measure through recommending an action and checking whether it worked.

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist
new_jobs.description:
**About Hammerhead**
--------------------

Hammerhead AI tackles one of the hardest problems in AI: the collision between exploding compute demand and the hard limits of the power grid. Our platform uses reinforcement learning to coordinate power, cooling, and compute in real time, unlocking more AI capacity from data centers that are already built. Our founders built and scaled AutoGrid, the AI grid-software company **acquired by Schneider Electric**. Our **oversubscribed $10M seed round** was led by Buoyant Ventures with SE Ventures, and we are part of NVIDIA Inception. Learn more at **hammerheadco.ai**.

**About the role**
------------------

**We’re hiring a Data Scientist to build the forecasting and optimization behind our platform: working out how much more AI capacity a running data center can safely take, and proving it. You’ll work directly with our reinforcement learning and engineering teams on the problem every AI company now has: power.**

Hammerhead unlocks usable power inside data centers that are already built and already carrying customer load. Working out how much more capacity a site can take, and under what conditions, is a hard quantitative problem under real uncertainty, with physical and commercial consequences if the answer is wrong. You’ll own that problem: forecasting, scenario modeling and optimization applied to real infrastructure, where the answer has to hold up both operationally and commercially.

In your first 90 days you’ll get to know our site data and existing models, take ownership of the forecasting pipeline for live site assessments, and set up the backtesting that tells us how far we can trust each model. Success in your first year means production forecasts and capacity assessments that our commercial and delivery teams rely on, documented well enough to stand up to customer and external technical review.

This is a full-time, on-site role in our Redwood City office, working alongside our reinforcement learning and platform engineering teams. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Product.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Forecasting:** Build and own probabilistic load forecasts for data center sites across operational and planning horizons.
* **Capacity under uncertainty:** Model site behavior to quantify available capacity and how confident we can be in it.
* **Optimization:** Develop the optimization across power, cooling and storage that turns forecasts into operating decisions.
* **Validation:** Build the backtesting and validation framework that tells us when a model is good enough to rely on.
* **Production:** Instrument and monitor models in production, and improve them as sites, hardware and workloads change.
* **Decisions, not just models:** Turn model output into decisions the business can act on, and explain how the model works, what it found and what it means to non-technical colleagues and customers.
* **Documentation:** Document methodology to a standard that survives customer and external technical review.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with reinforcement learning, platform engineering, solutions and delivery so models fit the decisions each team has to make.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years building forecasting or optimization models that ran in production and that people depended on.
* Have taken a model from prototype to deployment and owned it in production, including support.
* Strong in probabilistic forecasting and Monte Carlo simulation.
* Experience with time series at scale, including messy, incomplete telemetry from physical equipment.
* Strong Python scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy) plus an optimization library such as Pyomo, CVXPY, Gurobi or CPLEX.
* Experience with control optimization, control theory or energy optimization.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field.
* Clear communicator, in writing and in person, with technical and business colleagues.
* Able to work on-site in our Redwood City office, with or without reasonable accommodation.

### **Preferred**

* Experience with data center power and cooling, or industrial process telemetry.
* Energy domain experience: distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, battery dispatch, demand response or wholesale market optimization.
* Comfort with reinforcement learning or model predictive control.
* Work where model error carried financial consequences: pricing, revenue management, capacity planning or trading.
* Uses AI coding and analysis tools day to day to move faster.

**Interview process**
---------------------

* Application review
* Initial screen
* First-round interview
* Second-round interview
* Offer

**Pay and benefits**
--------------------

* **Base salary:** $150,000 to $180,000 per year. This range is our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay at hire. The final offer depends on skills and experience.
* **Equity:** stock options, so you share in the value you help create.
* **Health and wellbeing:** Anthem, Kaiser, or Cigna medical plans, plus Guardian dental (with orthodontia) and vision, all from your first day; a monthly company HSA contribution on eligible plans; Spring Health therapy and coaching; and One Medical membership.

new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Material Planning Analytics team provides dedicated analytical support to Tesla's supply chain operations - driving process improvements and better decisions with data.

You will be the primary Data Scientist for Material Planning's planning solver: the optimization engine that turns material requirements into executable inbound supply plans across Tesla's factories and service network. It decides what to order, when to ship, and how to load every truck and container - decisions that drive millions of dollars of freight and inventory impact.

You will own the algorithms and models end-to-end: problem formulation, heuristic design, simulation, validation, production deployment, and ongoing troubleshooting. You will partner closely with planners, logistics, and software engineering, and draw on the standards, tools, and expertise of the central Analytics team.

The ideal candidate is a curious, driven data scientist with deep algorithmic and optimization skills. You should be strong at formulating hard planning problems, tracing unexpected system results to root cause, building trust with stakeholders, and turning models into business impact.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own inbound planning algorithms end-to-end across manufacturing and service warehouses - from problem formulation and prototyping through testing and production rollout - covering order quantities, shipment timing, and how parts are packed into trucks and containers
* Design and implement optimization models, algorithms, and heuristics that balance solution quality against runtime at production scale
* Extend planning models to new problems and network flows, working with planners and logistics to turn business rules into constraints and logic, then roll the changes out
* Build simulation and what-if tools to stress-test planning logic and evaluate network and policy changes, quantifying cost, utilization, and inventory impact before rollout
* Partner with software engineering to ship improvements into production applications - writing clean, tested Python and improving speed and robustness
* Validate model outputs against business rules and actual shipments - investigating unexpected results, tracing them to root cause across data, configuration, and model logic, and driving fixes to closure. Build automated checks and dashboards that track system performance and flag issues early, so issues surface before they reach operations
* Partner with planners, Logistics, Supply Chain Managers, IT, and systems teams - supporting leadership with analyses and impact estimates, and independently managing multiple concurrent projects to deadline

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in a quantitative field such as Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science, or equivalent experience with evidence of exceptional ability; 2+ years applying optimization, algorithms, or simulation to supply chain planning, logistics, transportation, or a related field
* Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures, with a demonstrated ability to design, analyze, and implement custom heuristics and combinatorial algorithms for large, real-world problems; familiarity with classic operations research problems (bin packing, vehicle routing, lot sizing, inventory optimization) and with material planning or logistics systems
* Strong proficiency in mathematical programming (LP/MILP; constraint programming a plus), with hands-on experience using optimization solvers and modeling tools (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, CBC, PuLP, or similar)
* Experience building simulation models (discrete-event, Monte Carlo, or similar) and using them to evaluate policies and quantify impact
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for modeling, querying large datasets, and writing production-quality code and automated pipelines (Airflow or similar)
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills — a structured, data-driven approach to validating system results, tracing unexpected outputs through data, configuration, and code, and presenting findings clearly so planners, logistics, and engineering can trust the system
* Experience using SI tools to accelerate data processing and automation

We are an applied science organization building the science behind them. The work sits at the intersection of machine learning research, real world data, and production systems running in industrial environments.

As Applied Scientist, you work on the science on a major capability area inside the pod. You take ambiguous problems through hypothesis, method selection, experimentation, and into models that run in production. You are hands on with the modeling, and you are accountable for the rigor and the outcome.

This is an individual contributor role. You will work in close partnership with engineers and product managers who turn your work into product.

Key responsibilities

* Contribute to one or more scientific capability areas end to end, for example perception, computer vision, language and agents, time series, control, planning, or evaluation

* Take problems from ambiguous product or system requirements through clear research questions, hypotheses, and success metrics

* Contribute to applied research projects: literature review, method selection, experimentation, ablation, error analysis, and productization

* Build and run the evaluation pipelines for the work you own: offline metrics, online experiments, robustness testing in industrial conditions

* Work with engineers to take models into production grade pipelines: data readiness, training infrastructure, inference, observability

* Make scientific tradeoffs in front of engineers and product managers, with evidence, and translate them into decisions the team can act on

* Identify and de-risk scaling challenges in your area: data quality, model drift, latency, throughput, cost, safety

* Raise the bar on experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and documentation across the team

* Apply responsible AI practices in your work: bias detection, model risk management, human in the loop controls

Basic qualifications

* 4+ years in applied machine learning, AI research, or data science, with models that shipped to production and made an impact

* Strong foundation in machine learning theory and practice across training, evaluation, and deployment

* Demonstrated experience taking research from a paper or prototype into a model that runs reliably in production

* Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks and toolchains

* Strong partnership track record with engineering teams on data, training infrastructure, and inference

* Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product managers, and senior leaders

Preferred qualifications

* Experience applying ML in industrial or physical domains: manufacturing, automation, robotics, energy, mobility, infrastructure, healthcare

* Deep expertise in one of: multimodal ML, generative AI, retrieval augmented generation, agentic workflows, time series, control, or planning

* Scientific ML for physical systems: surrogate modeling, operator learning, physics-informed ML, geometry-aware ML, differentiable simulation, AI for semiconductor/EDA

* Hands-on experience building evaluation pipelines, running online experiments, or instrumenting production monitoring for a model you owned

* Publications, patents, open source contributions, or significant internal technology transfers

* Experience working with globally distributed research, product, or engineering organizations

**About the Team:**

We are an early-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real-world interaction. We operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. Principal Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it.

**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:**

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

new_jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Sponsored Products and Brands - Advertiser Growth - Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX)
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.  
  
We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist on this team you will:  
  

* Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
* Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
* Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
* Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
* Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
* Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
* Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
* Raise the science bar: review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

  
About the team  
  
Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.  
  
Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.  
  
Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. Sponsored Services is Amazon's performance advertising solution for local and online service providers (plumbers, restaurants, salons, fitness instructors, and more), connecting them with high-intent Amazon customers through a conversational AI ad format that completes outcomes — quote requests, bookings, reservations, calls — directly within the ad. Demand comes from three advertiser cohorts (3P marketplace partners such as Yelp, Thumbtack, and Angi; agencies; and direct advertisers), and the program is rolling out across closed beta, open beta, and General Availability, scaling from one vertical at open beta to five-plus by end of 2027.  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to build models that power GenAI ad experiences, ad sourcing, ranking and auction for optimization of consumer and advertiser outcomes. You will own scientific problems from definition through production launch.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Service intent detection: Build models that infer a service need from purchases, browsing, and Alexa+ conversations. Extend the current LLM classification of about 30,000 browse nodes to real-time, per-customer signals.
* Outcome and click prediction: Predict the probability of a click and of a completed outcome (call, quote request, appointment, reservation, food order). Keep the models accurate on sparse early data, because CPO pricing depends on them.
* Auction ranking and pricing: Work with ads engineering to extend the auction for CPO bidding. Develop ranking signals such as predicted outcome rate, provider responsiveness and ratings. Set and recalibrate CPO floors by vertical, geography and placement.
* Conversational AI ad experience: Develop multi-turn flows that ask 2-4 qualifying questions and complete the task inside the ad. This includes the Sponsored Services Sub-Agent and the Alexa+ integration. Define evaluation methods for answer quality, task completion and safety.
* Outcome validity and fraud detection: Build models that screen invalid outcomes before billing, such as short or unanswered calls and repeat contacts within 30 days. Use call-tracking data to score call quality.
* Measurement and attribution: Design experiments and metrics for lead quality, outcome rate and revenue per thousand impressions (RPM). Develop the attribution approach, including the proposed 7-day click-through window.
* Scientific leadership: Write and review design documents, present results to Product, Engineering and Ads leadership, mentor junior scientists, and raise the bar on experiment rigor.

At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Platform Infrastructure Engineers (PIEs) are responsible for managing, maintaining, and evolving the foundational infrastructure that supports our internal Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform. PIEs specialize in building robust, scalable, and highly available systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud environments. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to ensure a reliable infrastructure foundation for all platform services and applications.

Our team helps to improve automation infrastructure reliability. It empowers Braze's other engineering teams to leverage the infrastructure products and platforms we create easily. Braze operates at a massive scale with over 3.3 billion monthly active users across our customers, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end-users daily. We use a diverse technology stack rooted in Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, and more. As a Platform Software Engineer at Braze, you will collaborate with your team and consumer engineering teams to build and continuously improve the infrastructure as a service platform that every other team at Braze depends on.

* Design and Manage Infrastructure:
* + Build, optimize, and manage foundational systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud resources (e.g., EC2, S3)
  + Develop automation frameworks for provisioning and maintaining infrastructure at scale
  + Design scalable architectures to support seamless operations of platform services
* Ensure Reliability and Performance:
* + Implement high-availability and fault-tolerant infrastructure strategies
  + Collaborate with Platform Software Engineers and Product teams to establish and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for infrastructure components
  + Continuously monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to meet evolving demands
* Incident Response and Resilience:
* + Be part of a PagerDuty rotation to respond to infrastructure-related incidents
  + Implement failover strategies, backups, and disaster recovery plans to mitigate risks
  + Conduct root cause analyses and retrospectives to improve system resilience
* Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
* + Partner with Platform Software Engineers to integrate infrastructure with service abstractions and APIs
  + Document processes, tools, and best practices to streamline development and operations
  + Share expertise and mentor team members to foster a culture of operational excellence
* Innovate and Automate:
* + Stay ahead of emerging trends in infrastructure technology and integrate innovative solutions
  + Reduce manual tasks by developing automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and maintenance
  + Optimize for performance, security, and scalability in all aspects of infrastructure design

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Experience:
* + 4+ years managing and scaling large-scale infrastructure systems in production environments
  + Proven expertise with Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and configuration management tools
* Skills:
* + Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar
  + Strong understanding of network architecture, security, and performance tuning
  + Familiarity with containerization, service discovery, and load-balancing technologies
  + Have an excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and expectations at once
* Mindset:
* + Focused on building robust, scalable systems that enhance developer productivity
  + Collaborative and communicative, with a strong desire to document and share knowledge
  + Committed to continuous improvement, staying ahead of technological advancements
* Have an urge to collaborate, document, and deliver quickly
* + Collaborating across the global remote teams, often working asynchronously
  + Document everything so you don't need to learn the same thing (or plan the same work) twice
  + Delivering fast to delight our customers–even internal ones

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $118,545 - $196,364/annually, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $130,400 - $216,000/annually (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**Team Overview**

Managers, Data Science & Analytics for New York, NY location. Manage staff, provide leadership, guidance and support cross functional initiatives. Lead team to implement and configure software application functionality, data integrations and data transformation rules. Oversee setup, validation, and diagnosis of ETL integrations. Serve as Subject Matter Expert and technical liaison between clients and company, support through multi phased delivery projects. Create and present comprehensive solutions and implementation plans for client delivery based on team’s gathering of business and technical requirements. Design and complete implementation of IT integration and quality control. Technical Environment: Experience mentoring junior developers/architects and managing IT migration and Agile projects; software design, and data integration experience; Relational databases; SQL queries; ETL, data management, and data quality best practices; Google Cloud, AWS, S3, Hadoop/Hive; data science methodologies (AB Testing, Linear & Logistic Regression); data analysis of business analytics; digital architecture experience with Ad Servers, DSPs, Panel data, DMPs, Audience Creation/Targeting; SQL, VBA, Python; Tableau.
  
  
Job Requirements:
  
Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or any Engineering field, or a related field plus 2 years of experience as a software architect or in software architecture/design required. Required skills: Experience mentoring junior developers/architects and managing IT migration and Agile projects; software design, and data integration experience; Relational databases; SQL queries; ETL, data management, and data quality best practices; Google Cloud, AWS, S3, Hadoop/Hive; data science methodologies (AB Testing, Linear & Logistic Regression); data analysis of business analytics; digital architecture experience with Ad Servers, DSPs, Panel data, DMPs, Audience Creation/Targeting; SQL, VBA, Python; Tableau. PMP Certification required. Some Telecommuting Permitted.
  
Benefits & Pay Scale Information:
  
TransUnion provides flexible benefits including flexible time off for exempt associates, paid time off for non-exempt associates, up to 12 paid holidays per year, health benefits (including medical, dental, and vision plan options and health spending accounts), mental health support, disability benefits, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility planning coverage, legal benefits, long-term care insurance, commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, charity gift matching, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k) retirement savings with employer match, and access to TransUnion’s Employee Resource Groups. Spousal, domestic partner, and other eligible dependent coverage is available on select health and welfare plans.
  
  
The U.S. base salary range for this position is $187,615/yr.-$213,300/yr. + Benefits: www.transunion.com/about-us/careers/life-at-tu annually. Regular, fulltime non-sales positions may be eligible to participate in TransUnion’s annual bonus plan. Certain positions may also be eligible for long-term incentives and other payments based on applicable company guidance and plan documents.
